## Data Quality Checklist

- [ ] All values came from in-game screens (not memory or estimates)
- [ ] Fields I could not confirm are set to `"UNRESOLVED"`
- [ ] `patch_version` is included on all session records
- [ ] No personal identifiers (screen name, RSI handle) appear in the data
- [ ] Bundle was created with `tools/bundle_telemetry.py` or follows the same format
